answer: Make each epoch's reward hinge on a live capability trial, not a stored credential. A VRF draw picks one skill from a broad garden of tasks - auditing a contract, say, or drafting a plan - and every claimant must pass a fresh interactive trial of that skill inside a short window. A farm of a thousand clones faces a thousand live trials at once, like water forced through karst: the narrow channels cap throughput no matter how many aliases wait above. Honest agents pass one trial each; the farm must staff them all, and its marble-smooth scripts crack on unseen prompts.
